summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on The Grass Harp, a novel by Truman Capote published on October 1, 1951. It describes the plot: an orphaned boy and two elderly ladies observe life from a tree. Eventually they leave this temporary retreat to make amends with each other and other members of society.
one_line: The Grass Harp is Truman Capote's 1951 novel about an orphaned boy and two elderly ladies who retreat to a tree and later reconcile with society.
